title: [ty] Contain rendered code within Markdown fences
body: Source-derived type names can contain backticks and newlines. Wrapping a rendered hover type in a fixed three-backtick fence lets those names end the code block and inject active Markdown, including image URLs containing other inferred values. Choose a fence longer than every backtick run in the complete rendered value so hover content remains code.
